GeneDef.label: light of Auri-El
GeneDef.description: The Chantry's rites were meant to draw the sun's blessing down into the body, and the old priesthood passed that gift along in their blood. Carriers hold unusually deep reserves of magicka and can call up a brief ward of pale light.

GeneDef.label: winterborn
GeneDef.description: Generations in the far north gave the Snow Elves a calm in deep cold that others take for arrogance. They work and fight through a blizzard as though it were a light rain.

GeneDef.label: white-stone wright
GeneDef.description: The cut stone of Snow Elf halls still stands where every other work of that age has fallen. Carriers build and carve with a patience people find either admirable or maddening.
